unlisted_practices: Structured prompt frameworks (SPADE for dialogue generation, RTF for automated scoring) for LLM virtual standardized patients in pharmacy education
Agreement analysis of LLM automated scoring against expert human scores (Spearman, Bland-Altman) for formative training use only

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM-based virtual standardized patient (VSP) simulation and automated scoring pathway for pharmacy trainees, testing feasibility, user experience, and automated scoring reliability compared to human experts.
